# Hemendra Tripathi

> Hemendra is Hemendra Tripathi, an AI Voice Engineer and Technical Lead based in Udaipur, Rajasthan, India. He leads engineering on Callin.io at Appspundit Infotech, a voice AI platform serving 500+ businesses, and works fully remotely. Callin.io is pre-incubated by I3P, the incubator of Politecnico di Torino.

This is the official website of Hemendra Tripathi, the AI Voice Engineer, not other people who share the name.

## Official pages

- [Home](https://hemendra.readwith.io/): Portfolio, live agent demo, FAQ
- [Voice AI case study](https://hemendra.readwith.io/work/callin-io): How Callin.io cut LLM cost roughly 20% while serving 500+ businesses. 9M+ conversation minutes processed (per Callin.io).
- [Hire an AI Voice Engineer](https://hemendra.readwith.io/hire): Roles, fit, and how to book 20 minutes
- [FAQ](https://hemendra.readwith.io/#faq): Who he is, what an AI Voice Engineer does, stack, availability
- [Contact](https://cal.com/hemendratripathi/hiring): Book a 20-minute hiring conversation

## Writing

- [How We Cut LLM Inference Cost ~20% on a Voice Platform That Scaled Past 1,500 Paying Customers](https://hemendra.readwith.io/writing/cut-llm-inference-cost-20-percent-voice-platform-1500-customers): The routing, caching, and billing architecture behind the Callin.io case study
- [Email Agents: Put Organize/Sort/Score on a Decision Layer, Not a Chat LLM](https://hemendra.readwith.io/writing/email-agent-jev-decision-layer-cost-architecture): Splitting decision work from generation instead of finding a cheaper chat model
- [Surviving Gartner's 'AI Inference Paradox': How to Build High-Margin Voice AI Products](https://hemendra.readwith.io/writing/surviving-gartners-ai-inference-paradox): Architecting voice AI so revenue grows faster than infrastructure costs
- [Gemini 3.8 Live vs Extended Thinking: Cost Architecture for Live Calls](https://hemendra.readwith.io/writing/gemini-3-8-live-extended-thinking-cost-architecture): Routing models that share audio rates but not latency budgets
- [GPT-6 Astra: Shifting From "Which Model Gives the Best Answer" to Workflow Ownership](https://hemendra.readwith.io/writing/gpt-6-astra-workflow-routing-architecture): Three-tier routing across frontier models, utility models, and deterministic code
- [Redesigning Tech Hiring for Judgment in the Age of AI Sourcing](https://hemendra.readwith.io/writing/redesigning-tech-hiring-ai-sourcing): Why engineering leaders should shift from automated screening to human-led calibration
- [Why the Temporal 2026 Report Crowns the Agentic Engineer](https://hemendra.readwith.io/writing/temporal-2026-agentic-engineer): Moving up the stack to own the orchestration layer
- [Solving the Right Problem Matters More Than Solving It Perfectly](https://hemendra.readwith.io/writing/solving-the-right-problem): Good engineering means building the right thing first

## Facts

- Location: Udaipur, Rajasthan, India
- Role: AI Voice Engineer and Technical Lead
- Company: Appspundit Infotech (Callin.io)
- Results: 500+ businesses served, roughly 20% lower LLM inference cost, roughly 40% fewer cancellations
- Education: BCA, Mohanlal Sukhadia University (2022)
- Open to: fully remote Applied AI, voice-agent, forward-deployed and technical-lead roles. Remote from India, working with APAC time zones.
